questions.question: A Bible teacher saw a man with riches and honor who lacked nothing. What was the evil he saw in this?

answers.text: God does not allow him to enjoy them
He loses all of it in one night
His honor slowly turns into shame

questions.question: A Bible teacher said a man with a hundred children who is never satisfied with his wealth is worse off than whom?
A Bible teacher said all a man's labor is for his mouth. What did he say about that man's appetite?

answers.text: It is filled by hard work
